description: Source code for AV1 video encoder implementation using libaom, including configuration setup, encoding process, and handling of video frames and scalability layers.

classes.name: Av1VideoEncoder
classes.description: Implementation of an AV1 video encoder using libaom, supporting initialization, encoding frames, changing options, and handling scalability layers.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with specified profile, options, and callbacks.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a given video frame with specified encoding options.

methods.name: ChangeOptions
methods.description: Updates encoder options and reconfigures the encoder accordingly.

methods.name: GetFrameDuration
methods.description: Calculates the duration of a video frame based on metadata, options, or timestamp differences.

methods.name: DrainOutputs
methods.description: Retrieves encoded data packets from the encoder and outputs them.

methods.name: AssignNextTemporalId
methods.description: Assigns the next temporal layer ID for scalable video coding.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the encoder to process any remaining frames.

methods.name: UpdateEncoderColorSpace
methods.description: Sets color space parameters in the encoder based on the last frame's color space.
